about: Milliseconds vitest reports for one of Pele's stress tests run alone on the JavaScript build, before (main at 3eb7cd3, just after the regular expressions) and after this round, on the 4-core sandbox, 14 November 2026. Measured with timings.sh beside this file, on tests.tsv; run to run they vary by a tenth or so.

gantt worst cases 12,000 excluded dates over long tasks
gantt worst cases a custom format checked for every excluded day
gantt worst cases a date format of 25,000 tokens
state diagram worst cases the same class statement and transitions 1,500 times
venn worst cases one union of 300 sets
